from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentMatchInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, e.g. '《判决文书 1》'")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) identified in the document")
    matches_target_category: bool | None = Field(description="True if the document's cause of action matches the task requirement '知识产权与竞争纠纷', False otherwise")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentMatchInfo]
